ma.openBluetoothAdapter(Object object)

Initialize Bluetooth module (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String openBluetoothAdapter: ok

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String error message
state Number Valid only on IOS

object.state

Attribute Description
0 Bluetooth status unknown
1 Bluetooth status resetting
2 Bluetooth status is not supported
3 Bluetooth status is not authorized
4 Bluetooth status is not turned on

Sample Code

ma.openBluetoothAdapter({
  success: (res) => {
    console.log('openBluetoothAdapter success', res)
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'success',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })

  },
  fail: (res) => {
    console.log('openBluetoothAdapter fail', res)
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'fail',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  }
})
